summary: Observed a transient 503 SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE from the downstream gateway followed by rapid immediate retries (1/10 to 3/10) and a sudden 10x outbound request rate increase, culminating in a downstream payment gateway collapse with HTTP 429/503 responses, indicating a retry‑storm pattern.

evidence.excerpt: 2026-08-28T14:05:30Z ERROR [payment-client] Downstream payment gateway collapsed under retry stampede (HTTP 429 & 503 cascade)
evidence.interpretation: Shows the endpoint failure after the retry surge, confirming a stampede effect.

evidence.excerpt: 2026-08-28T14:05:05Z ERROR [payment-client] Outbound request rate amplified 10x (from 50 req/s to 500 req/s)
evidence.interpretation: Indicates a burst in request volume coinciding with retries.

evidence.excerpt: 2026-08-28T14:05:00Z WARN [payment-client] Downstream gateway returned single transient 503 SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE
evidence.interpretation: Initial transient failure that triggered retry logic.
First immediate retry attempt after the 503.
Second immediate retry, showing rapid succession.
Third immediate retry, contributing to the observed burst.
